submitted.rationale: Index 13 (Sb 0.249) had the highest measured EQE, 0.00065%. Its neighbours were close behind: index 11 (Sb 0.198) at 0.00062% and index 15 (Sb 0.303) at 0.00054%. EQE was lower at both ends of the line: 0.00046% at index 5 (Sb 0.08) and 0.00023% at index 21 (Sb 0.51). The peak falls at the Bi3SbO7 composition (Sb 0.25). That phase's predicted band gap is about 2.27 eV, below the 2.7 eV illumination, so it should absorb. BiSbO4 is predicted at about 3.06 eV, above the illumination energy, which is consistent with the low EQE at Sb 0.5. All EQE values are very small, so the ranking near the peak is within noise.

rejected.reason: Sb 0.51 (BiSbO4 region): predicted gap about 3.06 eV, above the 2.7 eV illumination; measured EQE was the lowest, 0.00023%.
Sb 0.08 (Bi-rich, sillenite or Bi2O3 region): measured EQE 0.00046%, lower than at Sb 0.25.
